We study the regularity properties of envelopes of quasi-plurisubharmonic functions in the context of the theory of envelopes of positive currents.

1) The quasi-psh envelope of a closed positive current in a Kahler manifold is a C^{1, 1} function, 2) The envelope of a closed plurisubharmonic function in a complex manifold is a C^1 function, and 3) The envelope of an arbitrary plurisubharmonc function in a Kahler manifod is a C^{2,\alpha} function.
(1) the regularity of the envelopes in question is independent of the choice of representative in the Kahler class, and (2) the envelopes are C^{1, 1} regular.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following problem.
the regularity of the quasi-plurisubharmonic (quasi-psh) envelopes of a given function in a given class.
the study of envelopes in complex analysis and geometric measure theory.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the regularity of the envelope of a family of quasi-plurisubharmonic functions is the same as that of the envelope of their local maxima.
the regularity of the quasi-psh envelope is determined by the regularity of its approximating sequence.
the quasi-plurisubharmonic envelope in a Kähler class is C1,1.
